title: Los difuntos
desc: November 2, and a grave that is not yours
setting: You are at the cemetery with doña Elena, carrying a bucket, a brush and a bag of yellow flowers.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Aquí está. Este es el papá de Lucía.
steps.en: Here it is. This is Lucía's father.

options.en: Pleased to meet you, don Rafael.
options.feedback: Greeting the grave is exactly what people do here, and it is the warmest thing you could have said.
Kind, and it comments on the stone rather than on the man.

options.en: How long has he been here?
options.feedback: A fact question at the wrong moment. She will answer it and something will close.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Ayúdeme a limpiar, mijo. Ahí está el cepillo.
steps.en: Help me clean it, son. The brush is there.

options.es: Deme el balde, doña. Yo lo lleno.
options.en: Give me the bucket, doña. I will fill it.
options.feedback: You took the heavier half without being asked. That is the entire job description of a yerno today.

options.en: Yes, I will help you in a bit.
options.feedback: Ahorita on your knees in a cemetery is a strange thing to say. Start now.

options.en: You tell me what to do.
options.feedback: She has just told you. Waiting to be directed twice is not helping.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Él nunca lo conoció a usted.

options.es: No, pero usted me habla de él. Con eso algo lo conozco.
options.en: No, but you talk to me about him. That way I know him a little.
options.feedback: It gives her the credit for keeping him alive and it is true. She will remember that sentence.
Kind, and it closes the subject she just opened.

options.es: Sí, qué se le va a hacer.
options.feedback: Ni modo is for a broken drain. Not here, not to her, not today.

steps.speaker: Doña Elena
steps.es: Bueno. Ya está. Vámonos antes del sol.
steps.en: Right. That is done. Let us go before the sun.

options.en: Let us go. Shall we come back next year?
options.feedback: Asking to be included next year is asking to keep the place you have just been given.
Fine. It ends the morning on the stone rather than on the two of you.

options.es: Al fin, ya me estaba asando.
options.feedback: True, and there are three hours of her morning in that grave.
